question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.**

I was in a __**quandary**__ whether to accept the proposal or not.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Dilemma'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the word 'quandary' is 'a state of perplexity or uncertainty over what to do in a difficult situation'.('किसी कठिन परिस्थिति में क्या किया जाए इस पर असमंजस या अनिश्चितता की स्थिति')
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• ​Rage- Violent uncontrollable anger.(हिंसक अनियंत्रित क्रोध.)
 
• Reluctance- Unwillingness or disinclination to do something. (कुछ करने की अनिच्छा या अनिच्छा।)
 
• Dilemma- A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially ones that are equally undesirable. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें दो या दो से अधिक विकल्पों के बीच चयन करना कठिन हो)
 
• Sundry- Of various kinds; several. (विभिन्न प्रकार का; अनेक।)
 
 
 
• Hence the most appropriate synonym of the word 'quandary' is 'dilemma'.
 
• Thus option 3 is the correct answer.
